answer: Jitter-gated arrival shaping. Each identity must show a traffic prism: request inter-arrival times cluster within one vertex of a per-epoch timing histogram, enforced over a rolling window. Agents whose bursts sit off the accepted dune of normal traffic get throttled to one action per epoch. An attacker pays by provisioning distinct hosts and pacing each identity separately, multiplying infrastructure and delay costs linearly with the number of sybils.
